$description: Print and PDF: formats, margins, bleed, grids, print type roles, press rules.

com.desertpants.source: Visual language derived from desertant.com (brand/index.css, assets/site.css, captured 2026-09-23/24). Logos, marks, product names, photography and copy are not included.

print.$description: Print and PDF. Physical sizes are exact in their native unit (inches for US formats, millimetres for ISO); $value carries the CSS-pixel equivalent (96px = 1in) and $extensions.physical the native value. Print always uses the light theme on white paper.

format.$description: Page formats in portrait orientation (width x height). Landscape swaps the two.

a4.$description: ISO A4: reports and letters outside North America.

arch-c.$description: ARCH C: small posters and wall charts (dp-poster).

arch-d.$description: ARCH D: posters and system maps (dp-poster); fits a 24in roll in portrait.

arch-e.$description: ARCH E: large wall charts (dp-poster); needs a 36in roll.

a1.$description: ISO A1: posters and system maps (dp-poster); fits a 24in roll in portrait.

a0.$description: ISO A0: large wall charts (dp-poster); needs a 36in roll.

slide-16x9.$description: 16:9 presentation page (PDF export of slides). Landscape only.

margin.$description: Page margins. Derived from the space scale at 1px = 0.75pt.

us.$description: Bleed beyond the trim for US formats (0.125in; 9.0pt).

iso.$description: Bleed beyond the trim for ISO formats (3mm; 8.5039pt).

offset.$description: Crop mark offset from the trim (9pt; 9.0pt).

gap.$description: Column gap on every print page (18pt).

baseline.$description: Baseline grid: half the 17pt body leading (8.5pt; 8.5pt).

header-offset.$description: Distance from the top trim to the running-head baseline (the rule follows below it at component.print-page.rule-gap) (24pt; 24.0pt).

footer-offset.$description: Distance from the bottom trim to the folio baseline (the rule sits above it at component.print-page.rule-gap) (24pt; 24.0pt).

descent.$description: Distance from the baseline to the bottom of every print line box, in em. The top edge sits at leading minus descent, so each line box is exactly leading x size tall and text holds the baseline grid.

type.$description: Print type roles. Size in pt = web px x 0.625; fluid roles use the 860px viewport value for portrait and the 1440px value for landscape.

portrait.$description: Row names and chart values. Portrait. 11.25pt.

landscape.$description: Row names and chart values. Landscape (same as portrait).
Figure captions and claims. Landscape (same as portrait).
Body copy (17pt leading = 2 baselines). Landscape (same as portrait).

portrait.$description: Secondary copy and table cells. Portrait. 8.75pt.

landscape.$description: Secondary copy and table cells. Landscape (same as portrait).
Eyebrows and running heads. Landscape (same as portrait).

portrait.$description: Meta lines and the folio. Portrait. 6.875pt.

landscape.$description: Meta lines and the folio. Landscape (same as portrait).
Footnotes and fine print. Landscape (same as portrait).

page.$description: Page ground: paper white. Cream is used for blocks and panels only, or matched by choosing a cream stock.

ink.$description: Press rules. Reference condition: FOGRA39 (ISO 12647-2 coated, ISO Coated v2). Every opaque and translucent colour token carries its FOGRA39 separation in $extensions.com.desertpants.print.cmyk-fogra39 (relative colorimetric with black point compensation; translucent colours composited over paper white).

small-text-k.$description: Text below print.ink.small-text-max-pt separates as 100% black only (no rich black), to avoid misregistration.

small-text-max-pt.$description: Threshold (pt) for the K-only text rule.

tac-max.$description: Maximum total area coverage (C+M+Y+K) under the FOGRA39 reference condition. Checked against every colour's separation.

image-min-ppi.$description: Minimum effective image resolution at final size.
